deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA)-based testing.

food industry.
DNA-based analysis has come to the fore in recent years as a direct
result of food safety and authenticity issues. Consumers are becoming
more apprehensive about what they eat and the food industry more
cautious in the products that they offer. Food authenticity and safety has
become a major issue, with increasing regulations worldwide.
In the pursuit of excellence, SGS Molecular continues to develop
innovative diagnostic and identification methods, providing a wide range
of services and products to its customers. SGS Molecular is ISO 9001
accredited and has ISO/IEC 17025 flexible scope accreditation in DNA-
